coverage_questions: The paper documents 38 tasks, but Supplementary File 1 containing exact schemas is unavailable; route-to-template mappings remain unresolved.
Exact prompt templates, field ordering, separators, numeric lexical mapping, tokenizer behavior, special tokens, attention masks, sequence boundaries, and loss masks are unspecified.
SFT combines instruction-response pairs with intermediate-reasoning-trace examples, but their exact target serialization and alignment are unspecified.
SFT uses sequence packing; RFT explicitly does not. Exact packing boundaries and example-to-sequence assignment are unspecified.
RFT starts from the SFT checkpoint and covers seven verifiable regression tasks, but the complete seven-task membership is not identified.
The DNAm age route has fixed multi-clock CpG panels and variable individual-clock panels; exact site lists and prompt schemas are unavailable.
The paper names additional TCGA survival, multi-mutant lifespan, general aging biology, and Olink task families, but their biological payload schemas are not documented.
The paper does not document numeric normalization, log transformation, dedicated numeric tokens, a prediction head, or a modality-specific encoder.
The paper does not establish a tokenizer or token-level receipt for Qwen3-14B; reconstruction ends at documented structured prompt text.

operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The paper documents packing multiple training examples into the SFT context, but the catalog has no operation representing example-boundary packing into a training context.
The paper documents instruction-response and reasoning-trace supervision, but the catalog has no operation representing causal training-label alignment or loss masking.

evidence.quote: Longevity-LLM  was  derived  from  Qwen3-14B 31 through  two  sequential  stages  of  fullparameter  fine-tuning:  supervised  fine-tuning  on  a  multitask  mixture  of  aging-related  prompt collections, followed by reinforcement fine-tuning on tasks with verifiable regression targets.
The training data comprised complementary prompt formats, featuring either a fixed set of  CpG  sites  curated  from  multiple  public  clocks
Predicting  chronological  age  from  DNAm  is  the  most  established use  case  of  the aging  clock methodology.
